description:
This brand new home in Herons Landing received our Premium Epoxy Floor system in their garage.

The homeowners chose a custom flake color blend to match the finishes on their home. We also brought the epoxy system up the walls, so that the homeowners can wash out their garage without worrying about getting the walls and baseboard wet!
